units.name: CountDownBonusDigit

units.name: DrawBonusCountdownDigits
units.summary: Expand two binary decimal digits through DigitTiles and place the two result sprites at the supplied display coordinates.

units.name: BonusScriptTrySpecialTransition
units.summary: Gate a rare actor transition on shared bonus state, distance at least $50 and a random byte below $14. Save the current animation and select animation 4; otherwise jump through the next script operand.

units.name: BonusScriptJumpCurrentActor
units.summary: Use X from the current actor contract to convert the next script address low byte into a relative cursor.

units.name: BonusScriptJump
units.summary: Reload current actor X, consume one low-byte target and continue dispatch at the relative cursor.

units.name: BonusScriptWait
units.summary: Consume a duration byte into the actor timer, advance past it and return for this tick.

units.name: BonusScriptSetCommonAttributes
units.summary: Consume one attribute byte and write it to every sprite in the current shape; advance by opcode plus payload and redispatch.

units.name: BonusScriptSetVelocity
units.summary: Consume signed X/Y movement bytes into the actor’s parallel velocity arrays, then continue dispatch.

units.name: BonusScriptRestoreSavedAnimation
units.summary: Restore the saved animation, clear the transition actor sentinel and reload animation state.

units.name: BonusScriptMoveLaneSelection
units.summary: Load a wait duration but retain this command until the current lane equals the selected lane. Move the selected actor X and Y by eight per lane step; on arrival advance and initialize the next actor.

units.name: BonusScriptWaitUntilLeftOfThreshold
units.summary: Hold a one-tick timer and retain this command while actor X is at least $91; advance only below that threshold.

units.name: BonusScriptFinishMode
units.summary: Advance the cursor, clear BonusActive and return through dispatch; the main bonus loop observes the completion latch.

units.name: BonusScriptClearHitAndReload
units.summary: Clear the bonus hit latch and select animation 5, restarting animation evaluation.

units.name: BonusScriptClearModeStateAndReload
units.summary: Select animation 5, clear CafePlayerThrowing and reload animation state.

units.name: BonusScriptResolveInteraction
units.summary: Call the existing bonus interaction helper for the current actor and return for this tick.

units.name: BonusScriptShowTimedIndicator
units.summary: Unless the shared blocking state is set, save actor and a $b4 timer and place a four-byte indicator sprite from actor reference coordinates. Then advance.

units.name: BonusScriptInitializeLaneActor
units.summary: If no failure is active, initialize the selected lane actor’s shape, animation, timer and coordinates from lane tables; advance the current actor cursor.

units.name: BonusScriptLaunchPathActor
units.summary: Save the current actor, derive horizontal distance/half-step and vertical path offsets, then arm actor 7 with shape 2, animation 6 and a one-tick timer.

units.name: BonusScriptSetTilesAndDuration
units.summary: Consume one tile byte per sprite in the shape, followed by one frame duration; save cursor and return for the tick.

units.name: BonusScriptDisableAndReduceDelay
units.summary: Deactivate the current actor through the spawn-delay helper and return for this tick.

units.name: BonusScriptDisableAndHide
units.summary: Deactivate the current actor and hide its first owned sprite, then return for this tick.

units.name: BonusScriptSetSpriteAttributes
units.summary: Consume one attribute byte per shape sprite, advancing OAM by four and the script cursor by one for each; redispatch.

units.name: BonusScriptSetPosition
units.summary: Consume integer X/Y coordinates into the actor arrays and immediately continue dispatch.

units.name: BonusScriptQueueAudio
units.summary: Consume one audio-command byte, save the next cursor and continue dispatch.

units.name: BonusScriptQueueConditionalAudio
units.summary: Consume one audio-command byte in either case; queue it only when the shared suppression state is zero.

units.name: TickAudioEngine
units.summary: Consume the queued audio command after shifting its high flag into carry. Zero updates existing voices; ordinary commands start four music voices; flagged commands start three effect voices. Effect channel ownership suppresses conflicting music register writes. Clear the command after all voices are saved.

units.name: TickMusicVoices
units.summary: For four active music voices, load scratch state, tick the stream and save state back to the structure-of-arrays voice store.

units.name: TickEffectVoices
units.summary: For three active effect voices, load scratch state, tick the stream and save it back. Voice indices four..six select the effect pointer tables.

units.name: InitializeMusicVoices
units.summary: Resolve and start four music voice streams for the selected command, then save scratch state into their slots.

units.name: InitializeEffectVoices
units.summary: Resolve and start three effect voice streams for the selected command, then save scratch state into their slots.

units.name: SaveAudioVoiceScratch
units.summary: Store sequence pointer, sequence/pattern cursors and pattern pointer from zero-page scratch into six seven-entry arrays indexed by voice.

units.name: LoadAudioVoiceScratch
units.summary: Load the selected voice sequence pointer, cursors and pattern pointer into the audio engine scratch fields.

units.name: ResolveMusicVoiceSequence
units.summary: Use voice index and the selected music command to form a pointer-table address; continue through shared voice initialization.

units.name: ResolveEffectVoiceSequence
units.summary: Translate effect voice index four..six to a local index and add the selected effect command to its pointer-table address.

units.name: InitializeAudioVoice
units.summary: Read the sequence pointer, clear note/loop/tie state and mark the voice active. Sequence commands select a pattern, jump, loop or terminate the voice.

units.name: ReadAudioSequenceCommand
units.summary: Read the next sequence command. $01 starts a pattern, $02 changes cursor, $03 manages a counted loop; any other byte ends the voice and releases its hardware channel.

units.name: StopAudioVoice
units.summary: Mark the voice inactive and release its APU channel unless an effect owns it.

units.name: AudioSequenceJump
units.summary: Replace the sequence cursor with the following byte and continue decoding.

units.name: AudioSequenceSelectPattern
units.summary: Read a pattern index and resolve a relative pattern pointer using the music or effect table. Reset pattern cursor and begin its event stream.

units.name: AudioSequenceCountedLoop
units.summary: On first encounter capture target and repeat count. Later encounters decrement the count and branch to the saved target until the loop finishes; then skip its three bytes.

units.name: AudioPatternSelectInstrument
units.summary: A negative event selects an eight-byte instrument record at $f000. Cache transpose and APU channel, then continue pattern decoding.

units.name: TickAudioVoiceStream
units.summary: If a note is still counting down, only apply the release/tie rule; otherwise fetch the next pattern event.

units.name: ReadAudioPatternEvent
units.summary: Pattern $ff returns to sequence decoding; negative bytes select an instrument. Other events combine note nibble, octave and duration lookup. Note zero is a rest unless a tie remains active.

units.name: TickAudioNoteDuration
units.summary: At the final tick release an untied note, then decrement its remaining duration.

units.name: ReleaseAudioChannel
units.summary: Disable the instrument-selected APU channel. Music voices yield to channels currently owned by effects; effects clear their ownership bit.

units.name: WriteAudioNoteToApu
units.summary: Claim/enable the selected APU channel, respecting effect priority over music. Use the instrument record and computed period to write pulse, triangle or noise registers; no DMC stream is used by this dispatch.

units.name: ApplyAudioVolumeBias
units.summary: Preserve upper control bits, add signed global bias to the four-bit volume and clamp to zero..fifteen.

units.name: ApplyTriangleControlBias
units.summary: Adjust the triangle control byte using the signed global bias and paired shift steps while preserving X. This is a mechanical interpretation; perceived envelope behavior is not established.
